About Me

I am a motivated and versatile student with strong interests in technology, business analytics, communication, debate, and creative arts. I enjoy combining analytical thinking with creativity to solve problems, build projects, and communicate ideas effectively. I am continuously developing my technical and professional skills through projects, extracurricular activities, competitions, and hands-on learning.

I'm a first-year BBA student at the Institute of Engineering & Management (IEM), Kolkata, and finished my 12th from Bagati Ramgopal Ghosh H.S. School under the West Bengal board. I've spent years training in painting and design alongside my business studies, and more recently picked up programming fundamentals in C, Java and Python.

What ties it together is a habit of showing up: for a UN committee floor at IntraMUN, for a finalist pitch at Logopreneur 2.0, for finance and economics workshops on campus, and for every art exam I've sat since school.
